name: The Eye of Paleth
summary: This quest sees an adventurer recover a blackened, pulsating gem known as the Cursed Eye of Paleth from the flooded wreckage of the Intrepid. Recovered at the behest of the haunted sailor Fitzsimmons, the malevolent artifact must be brought to Menethil Harbor so the dwarven priest Glorin Steelbrow can divine how to purge its blight.

sections.title: A Blighted Relic
sections.body: Beneath the treacherous waters of the Baradin Bay, resting inside the locked strongbox of the sunken vessel Intrepid, lies no ordinary treasure. The chest yields a blackened orb pulsing with an unsettling radiance: an Eye of Paleth. Rather than gleaning sacred light, this particular stone has been warped into an engine of suffering, heavily tied to the restless spirits and doom that claimed the sailors of the Third Fleet.

sections.title: Seeking the Priesthood
sections.body: Recognizing that such dark magic exceeds common salvage, the artifact is brought directly ashore to Menethil Harbor. There, Glorin Steelbrow, a dwarven priest of the Holy Light, inspects the anomaly. While stunned that such a sacred device was ever in the possession of the Third Fleet, Glorin immediately recognizes its unnatural taint and begins preparing the rites necessary to undo its dark influence.

faq.q: What is the Eye of Paleth?
faq.answer: The Eye of Paleth is an ancient and powerful sacred gem. Normally associated with holy energies, this particular specimen was aboard the sunken Third Fleet vessel Intrepid and has become twisted and cursed, radiating dark magic.

aliases: where do i find the eye
faq.answer: It is recovered from a locked strongbox aboard the flooded wreck of the Intrepid, resting just off the mist-shrouded coast of the Wetlands.

faq.q: Why does Glorin Steelbrow care about the artifact?
faq.answer: Glorin Steelbrow is a dwarven priest stationed in Menethil Harbor. As a practitioner of the Holy Light, he possesses the sacred knowledge required to recognize ancient relics and begin the rituals necessary to break sinister curses.

faq.q: How does Fitzsimmons know about the Eye?
faq.answer: Fitzsimmons is a survivor of the Third Fleet who remains haunted by the tragedy. Traumatized and taking refuge in Menethil's tavern, he knew of the dark relic hidden in the wreckage that tormented his fallen crewmates.

While its exact corruption remains tied to the supernatural demise and restless undead haunting the wrecked ships of the Third Fleet, the artifact absorbed dark energies during or after the catastrophe that sent the fleet to the ocean floor.

faq.q: What happens after giving the Eye to Glorin?
aliases: what to do with the eye
faq.answer: Glorin examines the cursed gem and determines that it cannot be left in its blighted state, directing the adventurer to cleanse the relic of its corrupting influence.

angles.text: Dealing with the defilement of a sacred artifact like the Eye of Paleth makes this investigation directly relevant to priests of the Holy Light.
Uncovering lost artifacts off the shores of Khaz Modan touches upon the dwarven dedication to reclaiming hidden relics, aided by Ironforge clergy like Glorin Steelbrow.
The Third Fleet was an Alliance expedition whose destruction left Menethil Harbor vulnerable; retrieving its remnants helps bring closure to lost comrades.
